sections.changelog: v1.2.110: Separates CSS Recipes from CSS Studio settings, changes Recipes to a shortcode-only browser that loads output into its editor on click, expands Content Studio Edit in Studio to save core WordPress fields, re-anchors Media Studio collection context menus beside the clicked row, and stabilizes Builder Tools by using an MV-owned fixed shortcut rail instead of moving external Bricks or Advanced Themer rails.
